title: Van’t Kruijsing — Head-Nod Chess
mapping: Destination files a–h map to D Dorian/minor-compatible scale degrees D E F G A B C D; destination ranks 5–8 raise an octave; Black uses the lower register. One half-move per beat, checks add a fifth, captures accent velocity. Accompaniment uses Dm9–Bbmaj7–Fmaj9–Cadd9.
